extractions.extraction_text: Hidrantes exteriores | Uno si la superficie total construida está comprendida entre 2.000 y 10.000 m 2 .  Uno más por cada 10.000 m 2  adicionales o fracción.(3)

attributes.norm_statement: Exterior hydrants must be provided based on constructed area.
attributes.satisfied_if: (BUILDING.AREA.CONSTRUCTED >= 2000 AND BUILDING.AREA.CONSTRUCTED <= 10000 AND HYDRANTS.EXTERIOR.COUNT == 1); OR (BUILDING.AREA.CONSTRUCTED > 10000 AND HYDRANTS.EXTERIOR.COUNT == (1 + CEIL((BUILDING.AREA.CONSTRUCTED - 10000) / 10000)))
